scheduler_action.action: Cancelled only the three-client paired controller after the long-prefix crossover was identified; left the independent S03 client and server alive.

cache_affine_restart.server_report: LCP similarity 1.000, f_keep 1.000; n_past 19749 with one token reevaluated.
cache_affine_restart.policy: Run additional seeds sequentially on the fully warmed prompt-family slot while unrelated work may use other slots.

finding: Continuous batching improves aggregate decoding only after the participating slots hold the prompt prefix. For long identical prompts, simultaneous cold submission redundantly serializes prefill and is dominated by cache-affine sequential seeds. Shared ownership remains useful across distinct tasks, but the scheduler must account for prompt affinity as well as slots and aggregate context.
